title: Ageing Schedule for Hardship Waivers on the Insulin Pump Program
content:
The age of the posting an approved hardship application names adds points to the share of a hardship waiver on an Insulin Pump Program:

| Named posting's posting date | Added to the share |
|---|---|
| more than 180 days before today (the long age days) | 10 points (the full aged points) |
| more than 90 days (the short age days) but not more than 180 days before today | 5 points (the partial aged points) |
| 90 days or fewer before today | nothing |

The age is counted in calendar days from the named posting's posting date to today.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical):**

| Age of the named posting | Points added |
|---|---|
| 90 days | none |
| 91 days | 5 |
| 180 days | 5 |
| 181 days | 10 |
